summary: The diff implements nearly all requirements. REQ-1 through REQ-6 are substantially addressed: branding updated to 'Odisha Exam' with tagline 'Video Materials and PDFs' in Navbar, Footer, index.html, and hero; stats section removed from HomePage; Science/Technology removed from all frontend areas and backend; General Studies with five sub-subjects added; English, Computer, Logical Reasoning added as standalone subjects; backend Category enum updated. One minor gap: the Navbar does not appear to include a subject navigation dropdown or list for the new categories — the navLinks array only contains Home, Courses, About, Contact. However, this may be fulfilled indirectly via the Courses page link. Admin authentication was changed, which was explicitly listed as a non-goal.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin authentication credentials changed: username set to 'odishaexam' and password to 'Odishaexam_2026#', with separate username and password fields on the admin login page.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly lists 'Changing the admin authentication mechanism' as a non-goal. The diff modifies useAdminAuth.ts logic and AdminLoginPage.tsx to use new credentials and a separate username field, which was not requested.
